topics.label: Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture context, key concepts, and learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cells acquire selective growth advantages through the combined effects of progressive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchy and stemness properties influence tumor initiation, propagation, and plasticity.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Dependency in Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how extrinsic microenvironmental cues, inflammatory signals, and supportive stroma are required to enable and sustain tumor development.

topics.label: Methods for Investigating Tumor Heterogeneity and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental technologies and computational approaches used to study cellular plasticity, mutational timing, and spatial interactions in tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Multi-Factorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks for the lecture and previews the upcoming topic.
